NARRATIVE PROVIDED BY DOT THE DOWN STREAM VALVE OF THE REGULATOR STATION WAS CLOSED DOWN ON THE SAME DAY. FGP, OUTLET VALVE WAS REOPENED ON OCT 11, 2018. LEAK SURVEYS OF THE HOSPITAL AND THE CONVALESCENCE CENTER WAS DONE AND OPEN ON THURSDAY. SERVICE VALVES FOR CUSTOMERS WERE CLOSED FOR PERSONNEL FROM DEFUNIAK SPRINGS ON OCT 11, 2018. Report Description
CALLER IS REPORTING THAT THE CITY OF CHIPLEY, AS A PRECAUTIONARY MEASURE DUE TO HURRICANE MICHAEL, SHUT DOWN A NATURAL GAS TRANSMISSION PIPELINE ON OCTOBER 10TH AT 1830 WHICH CAUSED THE LOSS OF GAS SERVICE TO THE CITY OF CHIPLEY. NARRATIVE PROVIDED BY DOT THE DOWN STREAM VALVE OF THE REGULATOR STATION WAS CLOSED DOWN ON THE SAME DAY. FGP, OUTLET VALVE WAS REOPENED ON OCT 11, 2018. LEAK SURVEYS OF THE HOSPITAL AND THE CONVALESCENCE CENTER WAS DONE AND OPEN ON THURSDAY. SERVICE VALVES FOR CUSTOMERS WERE CLOSED FOR PERSONNEL FROM DEFUNIAK SPRINGS ON OCT 11, 2018. PERSONNEL FROM OKALOOSA GAS SURVEYED THE CUSTOMER RESIDENCES ON OCT 13, AND ALL CUSTOMERS HAD GAS BY OCT 14. THE CITY AND UTILITIES WERE UNABLE TO CONTACT THE NRC DUE TO HURRICANE MICHAEL OUTAGES AND THIS IS BEING REPORTED BY THE DOT.

Report Description[NON-DOD SOURCE] NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: HYDRAULIC FLUID SPILLED TO LAND AND WATER | GLOBAL CONTAINER TERMINALS | STRAIT OF GEORGIA | DELTA, BC SWE DGIR 245143 NEW SPILL INFORMATION: DGIR #: 245143 ROC #: ------------------------------------------------------ INCIDENT DATE/TIME: 12/21/2024 15:00:00 INCIDENT DATE/TIME LOGGED: 12/21/2024 15:28:55 ------------------------------------------------------ DGIR LOCATION ADDRESS: 2 ROBERTS BANK RD, DELTA, BC DGIR LOCATION DESCRIPTION: AREA: TSAWWASSEN EMCR REGION: SOUTH WEST MOE REGION: LOWER MAINLAND JURISDICTION: FEDERAL PROVINCIAL ------------------------------------------------------ MATERIALS: HYDRAULIC FLUID - 200 L ------------------------------------------------------ DESCRIPTION OF SPILL SITE AND SURROUNDING AREA: DESCRIPTION OF SPILL SOURCE, CIRCUMSTANCES, CAUSE AND ADVERSE EFFECTS OF THE SPILL: REPORTING PARTY CALLING TO ADVISE THAT FOLLOWING THE FAILURE OF A SPREADER, THERE WAS A RELEASE OF 200L OF HYDRAULIC FLUID ONTO A VESSEL AND THE DOCK FACE OF THE ABOVE NOTED LOCATION. WHILE BRINGING THE SPREADER BACK ONTO THE DOCK FACE, APPROXIMATELY 1 TO 2 L OF MATERIAL ENTERED INTO THE WATER. A SUPERINTENDENT IS ON SCENE AND HAS BEEN UNABLE TO IDENTIFY ANY SORT OF SHEEN AT THIS TIME, AND PHOTOS OF THE WATER HAVE BEEN TAKEN. DETAILS OF ACTION TAKEN OR PROPOSED: REPORTING PARTY ADVISES THAT KITTY LITTER WILL BE SPREAD ONTO AFFECTED AREAS. FOLLOWING THIS, THE KITTY LITTER WILL THEN BE SHOVELED INTO GARBAGE BINS. DUE TO NO IDENTIFIABLE SHEEN ON THE WATER, THERE IS NO PLANNED REMEDIATION FOR THE WATERWAY AT THIS TIME.
